games.title: The Opera Game
games.black: Duke of Brunswick and Count Isouard
games.pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 Bg4 4. dxe5 Bxf3 5. Qxf3 dxe5 6. Bc4 Nf6 7. Qb3 Qe7 8. Nc3 c6 9. Bg5 b5 10. Nxb5 cxb5 11. Bxb5+ Nbd7 12. O-O-O Rd8 13. Rxd7 Rxd7 14. Rd1 Qe6 15. Bxd7+ Nxd7 16. Qb8+ Nxb8 17. Rd8#

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black has just developed the knight. What can White attack, and what can White do about Black's pieces?
pauses.reveal: Qb3 attacks the pawn on b7 and the pawn on f7 at the same time. Black cannot guard both easily, so White gains time.

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black has just played ...b5. Is it safe? Look at what the knight and the bishop on c4 can capture.
pauses.reveal: Nxb5 gives up a knight for a pawn, but opens the b-file and the diagonal to the king. White is ahead in development, so the attack comes first.

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black's king is still in the centre. Which of White's pieces can join the attack at once?
pauses.reveal: Castling long brings the rook to the open d-file with tempo. Developing with a threat keeps Black busy.

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black's pieces are tied up. Is there a check that wins material or leads to mate?
pauses.reveal: Bxd7+ removes a defender with check, and the following Qb8+ forces the knight away so that Rd8 is checkmate.

games.title: Légal's mate
games.pgn: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. Bc4 Bg4 4. Nc3 g6 5. Nxe5 Bxd1 6. Bxf7+ Ke7 7. Nd5#

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black's bishop on g4 attacks the queen. Do you have to move the queen?
pauses.reveal: No. Nxe5 lets Black take the queen, but the pieces left behind are ready for a mating attack on the king.

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black has taken the queen. What check is available?
pauses.reveal: Bxf7+ forces the king to e7, where it has nowhere safe to go.

games.title: Réti against Tartakower
games.pgn: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nf6 5. Qd3 e5 6. dxe5 Qa5+ 7. Bd2 Qxe5 8. O-O-O Nxe4 9. Qd8+ Kxd8 10. Bg5+ Kc7 11. Bd8#

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black's knight has just taken on e4. Look at the d-file and at Black's king.
pauses.reveal: Qd8+ is a queen sacrifice: the king must take, and then two bishop moves finish the game.

pauses.prompt: White to move. Black's king has taken the queen. What is the next check?
pauses.reveal: Bg5+ is a double check from the bishop and the rook on d1. The king can only go to c7, and Bd8 is mate.
